svg.title: The route to production
svg.desc: Seven steps take a new AI system or agent from registration to production: register, assess, initial approval, build or buy, test, deployment approval, roll out; for each, what the owner provides, who decides or acts, the result, and what the path changes.
svg.text: Seven steps from registration to production. The path set at step 2 decides what steps 3 to 6 ask for.

text.tspan: the controls of its level, with evidence
the DPO at both gates; the DPIA's measures in place
technical documentation, independent model validation, record keeping, a FRIA where required
the Gate 1 decision within [2 · 5 · 10] working days of a complete registration, on Light · Standard · Enhanced; on Light, Gates 1 and 2 can be one decision
